title: generate_deck
description: Make a whole presentation (corporate) or a training from the knowledge base or a document: the application reads the source and shows the person the outline to approve. Never for one slide or a cover ("cria a capa", "um diapositivo sobre X"): those are add_slide.

kind.description: corporate: a presentation; training: a course a trainer delivers.
kb_topic: what the knowledge base holds on a topic (query); kb_document: one KB document (domain, path); document: a project document (asset_id).

slides.description: Left out: the kind's usual size.

focus.description: What to keep to, in the person's words.

new_deck.description: Left out: a new deck. false: after the open deck's slides.
